research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: SambaNova Systems is researching and developing systems and methods for reconfigurable dataflow processors and architectures, as seen in titles such as 'System for Implementing Operations Having Dynamically-Sized Data Structures,' 'Implementing Matrix Multiplication on a Systolic Array with Reconfigurable Processing Elements,' and 'Lossless tiling in convolution networks.' Abstracts describe innovations in dynamic data structures, matrix operations, memory management, and efficient execution of AI and machine learning workloads, highlighting advances in both hardware and software integration.

about_short_description.short_description: SambaNova is a complete AI platform that delivers AI inference and scalable solutions, providing a seamless integration for agentic AI.

product.name: SambaCloud
product.description: A cloud-based AI inference platform providing fast access to open-source models through browser tools and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

product.name: SambaStack
product.description: A deployable AI inference platform combining SambaNova hardware, software, model management, and orchestration for dedicated or on-premises AI workloads.

product.name: SambaRack
product.description: An AI inference rack system built from SambaNova RDU chips for running large models with high throughput and reduced power consumption in data centers.

product.name: SambaNova RDU (SN40L)
product.description: A reconfigurable dataflow AI accelerator chip designed for efficient large-model inference using dataflow processing and a three-tier memory architecture.

product.name: SambaNova Suite
product.description: An integrated hardware, software, and model platform for training, fine-tuning, and deploying AI workloads, with emphasis on low-latency inference.

product.name: SambaManaged
product.description: A managed AI infrastructure service for operating SambaNova-powered inference environments without requiring customers to manage the underlying systems directly.
